info.name: Backend API (Complete)
info.description: Complete Postman collection for the Express ecommerce backend. All listed endpoints are implemented. Use mock SMS (SMS_PROVIDER=mock) locally; OTP appears in the server console as [otp-dev] phone=... otp=...... Also run: npm run test:e2e

Status: implemented

Preferred profile endpoint.
Response: { success, message, data: { user } }.
No reputation fields (reputation is admin-only).

Status: implemented

Browser redirect flow. Expect 302 when Google OAuth is configured.
After Google consent, backend callback redirects to FRONTEND_URL/auth/google/callback?code=<one-time-handoff-code> (tokens are NOT in the URL).

Status: implemented
Auth: none
Google OAuth provider callback (backend URL). Not for manual Postman use.
On success redirects to frontend /auth/google/callback?code=<handoff>.

Status: implemented
Auth: none
Exchange one-time Google handoff code from frontend callback query for tokens.
Body: { code }.
Response: { success, message, data: { accessToken, refreshToken, user } }.
Code is single-use, TTL 60s.

Status: implemented
Auth: Bearer JWT
Legacy response shape: { success, message, user } (user is top-level, not data.user).
No reputation fields.

Status: implemented

Status: implemented
Auth: none
Body: { accepted: true } or { over21: true }.
Response: { success, message, data: { approved, ageGateToken, expiresIn: "30d" } }.
Frontend stores ageGateToken client-side. Backend does not enforce on catalog routes yet.

Status: implemented
Auth: none
Body: { accepted: false } or { over21: false }.
Response: { success, message, data: { blocked: true } }.
Frontend should redirect to /blocked after calling this.

Status: implemented
Auth: customer Bearer JWT
Body: { addressId, paymentMethod?: "COD" } — use addressId (NOT deliveryAddressId). paymentMethod is optional; always stored as COD.
Triggers admin SMS alerts (mock logs [mock-sms]). Response includes data.smsAlert.

Status: implemented
Auth: customer Bearer JWT
Allowed from Pending, Confirmed, or OutForDelivery.
Required body: { cancelledFromStatus: "Pending"|"Confirmed"|"OutForDelivery", note?: string }.
Body.cancelledFromStatus must match the current order status (409 if stale).
Delivered orders cannot be cancelled. Admin-only reputation is adjusted on customer cancel.

Auth: admin Bearer JWT
DB-first flatten of Product.images across products.
Query: page, limit, search (product name), includeArchived (true = hidden + soft-deleted products).
Response data: { items, pagination, summary: { totalImages, totalBytes } }.
Delete from media UI: reuse DELETE /api/admin/products/:productId/images/:imageId.
